description: M4 IL-LIM-001/002 inference-unresolved lane (docs/work/task-m4-il-lim001-002-inference-limitations.md): registered alongside coverage.ts's augmentationInferenceUnresolvedDetails() producer for the same reason 25-28 exist - an unregistered severity:'warning' code falls through surfacesLimitation()'s default and penalizes an honest disclosure using this code's own recommended wording. This code discloses relationships augmentation RECOGNIZED but could not resolve into a specific caller (gate 7 measured ~40% of real references silently dropped this way before this lane existed) - the message must state both halves commander required: the static graph is unaffected, AND the caller list at these points may be incomplete (understating impact), never only the first. Must-pass fixture, verified by running the engine.
